_about: Repairs of extraction damage in sm-qbank's text that the import cannot make itself (ours, docs/ICAI_BANK.md §9.2, §10): the text is ICAI's, copied from the rendered PDF page. Key: <doc id>:<item key>. tools/bank/smimport.py replaces the item's field from the 'from' text to its end with 'text', and warns when 'from' is no longer found.
